note: Denali Borough zoning (Title 9.15, Ord. 06-14: R-1, R-R, R-C, M-U, I) is defined only in ordinance text and PDFs; the borough says land is general use by default. No zoning district polygon layer is published as a service. The borough's dbgis web apps (commercial land use permit map) expose no REST services. The state DNR Denali Borough Parcels layer (FeatureServer/1) has no zoning attributes, so it is not usable as a fallback. Borough has no incorporated cities that zone separately.
